title: Workforce Education and Development, B.S. — Industrial Education Specialization (College of Education)
notes: Historical year built from the archived 2022-23 bulletin (fetched raw HTML directly, not via WebFetch summary, per the batch's anti-hallucination instruction; per-semester subtotals in the archived page's own 'Suggested Academic Plan' table -- 14.5+16+17+17+15+15+13.5+13 -- sum to the page's own printed 'Total Credits 121', confirming the extraction is internally consistent). Confirmed byte-identical to WFED-2026.json's Suggested Academic Plan course sequence and to its Program Requirements 'Industrial Education Option (43 credits)' course list (WFED 395A x6 = 24cr + WFED 495C = 10cr + 9cr Supporting Courses/Related Areas = 43cr); also confirmed identical Entrance-to-Major requirements (3.00 cumulative GPA, 80 documented experience hours, same five prescribed courses) and identical 'At which campus can I study this program?' Begin/End Campus text (Any Penn State Campus / University Park). The archived page's own Degree Requirements intro still states 'a minimum of 124 credits is required' even though its own Suggested Academic Plan sums to 121 -- this is a pre-existing bulletin-internal inconsistency present in this 2022-23 edition too, not something introduced by or unique to the 2026 bulletin. Real bug fixed (same one WFED-2026.json already fixed, confirmed present since at least this edition): the archived 2022-23 university-course-descriptions/undergraduate/wfed/ page's own printed prerequisite lines show WFED 441's prerequisite is WFED 445, and WFED 442's prerequisite is WFED 441 (WFED 445 itself requiring WFED 105 plus fourth-semester standing) -- yet the Suggested Academic Plan schedules WFED 441 in Year 2 Fall and WFED 442 in Year 2 Spring, both before WFED 445 (Year 3 Spring). Applied the identical reordering WFED-2026.json uses: WFED 105 -> WFED 445 -> WFED 441 -> WFED 442, moving WFED 441 to Semester 7 and WFED 442 to Semester 8 to respect the real prerequisite chain. Genuine per-year difference found (unlike 2026): the 'Additional Courses: Select one of the following' item (Semester 7, 3cr) lists three real, valid options in this edition -- LDT 100 (World Technologies and Learning), STS 245Z (Globalization, Technology, and Ethics), and WFED 450 (Cultural Diversity in the Workplace). Confirmed STS 245Z was a genuinely real course in the archived 2022-23 university-course-descriptions/undergraduate/sts/ catalog (3 credits, same title later kept under STS 245N -- see WFED-2023.json's notes for the confirmed rename) -- unlike the live 2026 catalog where 245Z no longer exists (WFED-2026.json's own finding). Modeled all three real 2022-era options here. Note for the reviewing process: WFED-2026.json's own 'Additional Courses' item currently lists only WFED 450, omitting the real, still-current LDT 100 option that this same page's Program Requirements table also lists for the 2026 edition -- flagged here rather than edited, since fixing WFED-2026.json's own item list is outside this batch's assigned scope (historical years 2022-2025 plus the campus field). All Gen Ed 'Selection' slots (Science, Humanities, Mathematics, Social/Behavioral Science, Art) remain generic per-2026.json's own established convention, since this edition's Gen Ed policy text (Foundations/Knowledge Domains breadth figures) doesn't attach a specific domain code to any of WFED's own bare, un-prefixed labels here either -- same 'never fabricate' rationale as 2026.json.
